title: Two ancient statues unearthed during excavation at Karachi's Lea Market
description: Two ancient statues have been discovered during excavation work at Lea Market in Karachi's old city area, 24NewsHD TV reported on Friday.

title: Sand samples telling story of ancient Esperance coastline to be presented at Wildflower Festival
description: Samples of sand taken from across the Esperance archipelago will explain how the region’s pristine coastline has shifted over thousands of years.

title: Scotland planted trees on ancient peatland. Now it is removing them
description: The ancient peatlands of Scotland are undergoing a significant restoration, which addresses the detrimental effects caused by tree planting. Conservationists are diligently working to eliminate commercial trees, aiming to enhance wildlife habitats and maintain stored carbon levels. This notable effort is primarily focused on the Flow Country, a treasure trove of wetlands recognized as a World Heritage Site for its global ecological importance.
